title: Category
description: Optional display metadata for a category folder, in a `_category.json` sidecar. Overrides the folder-name-derived title (which can't punctuate or translate) and can add a per-language name and an icon. See docs/PLANNING.md §4.

title.description: Display name for languages without a `titles` entry (and the global name for categories that don't translate, e.g. "Film & TV").

titles.description: Per-language display names, keyed by language code; falls back to `title`, then the title-cased folder name.
